snippet.title: Praise, My Soul, the King of Heaven (Instrumental) Traditional Peaceful Hymn arranged by Tim Janis
snippet.description:
Praise, My Soul, the King of Heaven (Instrumental) Traditional Beautiful Peaceful Hymn arranged by Tim Janis. Praise, My Soul, the King of Heaven is a beautiful traditional hymn written Henry Francis Lyte. I am so inspired by the beauty and peace of this hymn and glad to share my arrangement with the beautiful setting of nature. 
It's our wish that you find peace, hope and relaxation when watching and listening to this video. 

Praise, my soul, the King of heaven;
to his feet your tribute bring.
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
evermore his praises sing.
Alleluia, alleluia!
Praise the everlasting King!

Praise him for his grace and favor
to his people in distress.
Praise him, still the same as ever,
slow to chide, and swift to bless.
Alleluia, alleluia!
Glorious in his faithfulness!

Fatherlike he tends and spares us;
well our feeble frame he knows.
In his hand he gently bears us,
rescues us from all our foes.
Alleluia, alleluia!
Widely yet his mercy flows!

Angels, help us to adore him;
you behold him face to face.
Sun and moon, bow down before him,
dwellers all in time and space.
Alleluia, alleluia!
Praise with us the God of grace!

In this beautiful hymn we find the peace and beauty of God's comfort. Please enjoy my arrangement while we view nature and feel it's peace. We pray peace be with you always,
Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Bella and Roo Roo 

 Arranged by Tim Janis 2026
